compos.text: Alt text: "Emergency app interface on a smartphone screen. The top section has a red background with the text 'Emergency' and two tabs labeled 'ALERTS' and 'PLACES,' with 'PLACES' highlighted. Below, there is a toggle switch labeled 'Track current location.' The main section displays 'Cranford, NJ' with icons indicating monitored hazards and people. A red circular button with a plus sign is located at the bottom right corner."
Text notification indicating that "San Francisco, California is added."
A red button with the text "FINISH" in white, indicating the completion of a task or process.
Text on the smartphone UI element reads: "Easily manage your monitored locations in the Places tab."

"Smartphone status bar with various icons and indicators. From left to right: email notification icon, missed call icon, alarm clock icon, do not disturb icon, lock icon, battery icon, Bluetooth icon, Wi-Fi icon, and the current time displayed as 6:31."
Alt text: "Back button icon, represented by a left-pointing triangle."

compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is part of an application that allows users to manage and monitor locations. The main content of the screen indicates that "San Francisco, California is added" to the monitored locations. It suggests that users can easily manage their monitored locations in the "Places" tab. The screen also features an image of a smartphone displaying the "Emergency" section of the app, with tabs for "Alerts" and "Places." At the bottom of the screen, there is a prominent red button labeled "FINISH," likely to complete the current action or setup process.
